description:
GlareWheel KATV-01 Dirt Quad Kids 36V Electirc 4-Wheeler for Ages 6+,big enough to tackle rugged off-road terrain, this pumped-up dirt quad is the perfect step up in size and adventure for older riders.

Off-road terrain: with a telescopic shock absorber, effectively reduces the vibration of the ATV,makes the riding more smoothy and comfortable.

Pneumatic tires absorb the un-evenness of terrain. This allows for a smoother ride, and less bumping and shaking. Also have a thicker tread, which provides traction to drive over loose and uneven surfaces.

App: App Control: build in Bluetooth speaker, can play your music and set up LED light color, change ATV speed mode.

LED battery indicator light shows battery volume easy monitor

Max speed – Up to 10mph,3 speed gear: Kids mode 3mph, Normal mode: 5mph, Sports mode: 10mph

components.description: 6 years old and up, Weight limit 165 lbs.
